data.body:
Implementation complete in worktree (branch fix/e39f-relation-unlink).

GREEN: 29/29 targeted tests pass (tests/interfaces/lifecycle/test_unlink_relation_scoped_e39f.py + tests/unit/rebar_reconciler/diffing/test_inbound_link_removal_2b16.py). Broader related suites: 447 passed, 1 skipped (tests/scripts/graph, facades/test_cli.py, test_leaf_writes_parity.py, test_ticket_delete_unlink_scan.py, unit/rebar_reconciler/diffing). make lint exit 0; make typecheck clean (429 files).

MUTATION CHECK (verdict: PASS): temporarily restoring the pair-scoped call in _inbound_unlink_one (rebar.unlink without the relation argument) turned both e39f convergence tests RED (test_e39f_inbound_removal_converges_for_a_double_related_pair, test_e39f_double_related_reapply_is_idempotent); restoring the relation-scoped call turned them GREEN again. The tests detect the defect, not the diff.

Changes: graph/_links.remove_dependency (relation-scoped seam, symmetric with add_dependency; ValueError on non-canonical relation; relates_to reciprocal removal); _commands/unlink.py threads optional relation through _get_link_info/_write_unlink/unlink_core/unlink_cli (no-relation path byte-for-byte pair-scoped as before); _lib_writes.unlink gains optional relation; apply_inbound_records._inbound_unlink_one now relation-scoped — the G5 mismatch DECLINE branch is structurally unreachable and removed (no-link case remains a logged INFO no-op, preserving the G5 safety invariant: never remove a link the peer still carries). Docs: help/unlink.txt, regenerated cli-reference.md, user-guide.md.

Out of scope, noted: MCP unlink_tickets(id1, id2) keeps pair-scoped signature (not in the ratified decision); relation-scoped removal reachable over MCP indirectly via reconciler only. Never-pushed managed-link discrimination deferred to a4bd-4ca8-c44f-49bb.
